Package com.rpglab.game.items

Class Weapon

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.items.Weapon
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Item
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    Bow, ExtremeSuperBow, MoonStaff, Staff, SuperBow, Sword, WillowStaff
    public abstract class Weapon
extends java.lang.Object
implements Item
    Abstract base class for all weapons in the Dungeon Adventure RPG. Weapons are items that can be equipped by characters to increase their combat effectiveness. Each weapon has damage output, level requirements, and a unique name for identification.

    Weapons implement the Item interface and provide the foundation for all combat equipment in the game. Different weapon types extend this class to provide specialized functionality for various character classes.
